objective: Find a detector small enough for a practical MAX deployment while retaining the validated YOLO11s fruit accuracy.

rejected_continuations.name: yolo11n-640
rejected_continuations.reason: MPS source-training throughput was too slow for the iteration loop; stopped after epoch 2 with mAP50 0.614.

rejected_continuations.name: unfrozen-default-warmup
rejected_continuations.reason: The default 0.1 bias warmup destabilized the validated checkpoint.

rejected_continuations.name: unfrozen-low-rate
rejected_continuations.reason: Full-backbone gradients were slow and reduced validation accuracy rather than improving it.

verdict.reason: YOLO11n retains 92% of YOLO11s mAP50 and 94% of mAP50-95 with 73% fewer parameters, passes the existing MAX importer operator gate, and matches the exported ONNX numerically. It still requires a Woof-native MAX latency, thermal, live-camera, and fixed-corpus parity gate before it may control motion.

notes: Local MPS inference timing is not a Woof MAX runtime benchmark.

The fixed-threshold evaluator uses source-image labels and path-preserving directory inference; earlier list-source calculations were discarded because Ultralytics replaced source paths with synthetic names.
No candidate from this experiment was deployed or connected to autonomous motion.
